# Delta Fleet

> Delta Fleet designs, deploys and manages custom multi-agent AI ecosystems ("fleets") for high-growth companies: 500+ trained specialist agents that run quote-to-cash, finance operations, data corridors, customer support and marketing — supervised by humans through an asynchronous dashboard called Agentloop, with local sandboxed execution on dedicated hardware (The Swarm).

Key facts:
- Pricing: fixed-fee fleet build $10,000–$25,000+ (CapEx), managed retainer $500–$3,000/month (OpEx) covering hosting, APIs, monitoring and continuous workflow updates.
- Typical squadron: 3–10 specialist agents per workflow corridor, with human approval gates on outbound artifacts and exception-first async reporting.
- Beachhead: revenue operations for B2B companies (Salesforce · NetSuite · Stripe corridors); also professional services and financial services.
- Infrastructure: local-first sandboxed execution; frontier cloud models reached only through a masked, logged gateway.
- Deployment arc: workflow audit → shadow mode → gated autonomy → business-as-usual, typically inside one quarter.

This site is a single-page application with hash routing; all page and article content ships in the initial HTML source (inert <template> elements), so full text is available without JavaScript execution.
